description: We are seeking a Data Scientist to build predictive models and ship them to production. You will work in Python with pandas, scikit-learn and PyTorch, write SQL against our warehouse, and use MLflow to track experiments. Strong grounding in statistics, feature engineering and machine learning is required. Experience with AWS, Docker and large language models is a plus.

As a Senior Data Scientist you will own the full modelling lifecycle: exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model training and evaluation. Daily tools are Python, SQL, scikit-learn and Spark. You will partner with data engineers to productionise models on Kubernetes and communicate findings through data visualization in Tableau. Background in statistical analysis and A/B testing expected.

Join our applied science team to build NLP systems. You will fine-tune transformers and large language models, run retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and evaluate models rigorously. Stack: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, and vector databases. Familiarity with prompt engineering, deep learning and cloud deployment on GCP is important. SQL and solid statistics round out the role.

We need a Data Scientist to support pricing and risk. Responsibilities include regression and classification modelling, predictive modeling, and building dashboards. You should be fluent in Python and R, comfortable with SQL, and experienced in statistical modeling. Exposure to machine learning operations, Airflow and Snowflake is welcome. Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders is essential.

This Data Scientist role blends analytics and machine learning engineering. You will build recommendation and forecasting models in Python using scikit-learn and TensorFlow, deploy them with Docker on AWS, and monitor them in production. Skills: SQL, feature engineering, experimentation, data visualization. Understanding of deep learning and generative AI is a strong advantage.
